Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (48g), Fiber (4g), Vitamin C, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Maida (All-purpose flour), Ghee/Oil, Baby potatoes, Tomato puree, Ginger paste, Cumin seeds, Hing (Asafoetida), Bhaja Masala (roasted cumin & dry red chilli), Bay leaf, Turmeric
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead maida into a smooth soft dough with oil/ghee and water; roll small discs and deep fry in hot oil until puffed white luchis. 2. Boil baby potatoes. 3. Sauté bay leaf, cumin, hing, ginger paste, and tomato puree. Add potatoes, dry spices, water and simmer till gravy thickens. Sprinkle bhaja masala.

Dish Name: Jain Radhaballabhi with Hing Aar Alur Dom
Key Nutrients: Protein (9g), Fat (17g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Potassium
Ingredients Required: Maida, Biulir Dal (Soaked Urad dal), Hing (Asafoetida), Fennel seeds (Mouri), Green chillies, Baby potatoes, Tomato puree, Bhaja masala, Mustard oil, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind urad dal with green chillies, saunf, and generous hing; sauté paste in oil till dry. 2. Stuff spiced dal inside maida dough balls, roll gently and deep fry puffed Luchis. 3. Cook baby potatoes in tomato, hing, and cumin gravy without onion or garlic.

Key Nutrients: Protein (8g), Fat (16g), Carbohydrates (46g), Fiber (6g), Iron, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Maida, Fresh green peas (Koraishuti), Green chillies, Hing, Cumin seeds, Fennel seeds (Mouri), Mustard oil / Vegetable oil for frying, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Grind fresh green peas with green chillies into a smooth paste. 2. Sauté paste in oil with hing, cumin, mouri powder, and salt until moisture dries up into a tight filling. 3. Stuff inside flour dough, roll into discs, and deep fry until golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (18g), Fat (26g), Carbohydrates (45g), Fiber (3g), Iron, Selenium
Ingredients Required: Maida flour, Eggs, Minced chicken/mutton (optional), Finely chopped onions, Green chillies, Coriander leaves, Garam masala, Mustard oil/Ghee for shallow frying
Recipe Instructions: 1. Roll maida dough into a thin large square sheet. 2. Beat eggs with chopped onions, green chillies, coriander, spices, and pre-cooked minced meat. 3. Pour egg mixture in center of dough sheet, fold edges to seal like an envelope, and shallow fry on medium heat till golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (9g), Carbohydrates (26g), Fiber (7g), Calcium, Iron, Vitamin C
Ingredients Required: Bitter gourd (Karela), Raw banana, Green papaya, Sweet potato, Drumsticks, Bori (Lentil dumplings), Mustard oil, Panch Phoron, Radhuni (Celery seeds), Mustard paste, Poppy seed paste, Mustard oil
Recipe Instructions: 1. Fry Karela and Bori separately in mustard oil. 2. Temper oil with Panch phoron and Radhuni. Add vegetables and sauté briefly. 3. Add water, mustard-poppy paste, and simmer till vegetables cook. Finish with crushed radhuni and mustard oil.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (9g), Carbohydrates (25g), Fiber (6g), Calcium, Iron
Ingredients Required: Bitter gourd, Raw banana, Green papaya, Ridge gourd, Drumsticks, Bori, Mustard seeds, Radhuni seeds, Poppy seed paste, Milk, Ghee, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Fry karela and bori in ghee. 2. Temper ghee with mustard seeds and radhuni. Sauté non-root vegetables (raw banana, papaya, karela, drumsticks). 3. Add poppy seed paste, water, and splash of milk; simmer till soft. Ghee finish.

Dish Name: Bhaja Muger Dal with Aloo Jhuri Bhaja
Key Nutrients: Protein (12g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (6g), Folate, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Yellow Moong dal, Roasted coconut slices, Green chillies, Bay leaf, Dry red chilli, Cumin seeds, Ginger paste, Ghee, Potatoes (julienned & crispy fried), Salt, Sugar
Recipe Instructions: 1. Dry roast moong dal till aromatic and golden; wash and boil with turmeric. 2. Temper ghee with cumin, bay leaf, dry red chilli, and ginger paste. 3. Add dal, roasted coconut pieces, sugar, and simmer. Serve with ultra-thin crispy fried potato juliennes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (34g), Fat (36g), Carbohydrates (4g), Fiber (1g), Omega-3 Fatty Acids, Vitamin D
Ingredients Required: Ilish (Hilsa fish) steaks, Yellow & Black mustard seeds paste, Poppy seeds paste, Kalo Jeere (Nigella seeds), Green chillies, Mustard oil, Turmeric, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate Ilish steaks with turmeric, salt, and mustard oil. 2. Mix yellow mustard, black mustard, and poppy seeds paste with water, turmeric, and green chillies. 3. Heat mustard oil, temper nigella seeds and green chillies, add mustard gravy and fish; simmer gently for 8-10 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (28g), Fat (32g), Carbohydrates (12g), Fiber (2g), Selenium, Zinc
Ingredients Required: Golda Chingri (Jumbo Prawns), Thick Coconut milk, Onion paste, Ginger-garlic paste, Garam masala, Whole spices (Cinnamon, Cardamom, Cloves), Ghee, Mustard oil, Sugar, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Clean prawns and lightly fry in mustard oil. 2. Temper ghee and oil with whole cinnamon, cardamom, cloves. Add onion, ginger-garlic paste and sauté until golden. 3. Add spices, coconut milk, fried prawns, and simmer till thick creamy sauce forms.

Key Nutrients: Protein (5g), Fat (15g), Carbohydrates (29g), Fiber (4g), Potassium
Ingredients Required: Thin sliced Brinjal (Eggplant), Besan (Gram flour), Kalo jeere (Nigella seeds), Baking soda, Red chilli powder, Mustard oil for deep frying, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Slice brinjal lengthwise thinly; sprinkle salt and turmeric. 2. Prepare thick besan batter with kalo jeere, red chilli powder, baking soda, and cold water. 3. Dip brinjal slices in batter and deep fry in hot mustard oil until puffed and crispy.

Key Nutrients: Protein (10g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (26g), Fiber (5g), Iron, Folate
Ingredients Required: Yellow Moong dal (soaked & ground), Green chillies, Hing, Cumin seeds, Coriander leaves, Mustard oil / Ghee, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Coarsely grind soaked moong dal with green chillies. 2. Whisk paste vigorously with hing, cumin seeds, and salt. 3. Drop small lemon-sized balls into hot mustard oil and deep fry on medium heat till golden crisp.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (7g), Carbohydrates (28g), Fiber (3g), Vitamin B, Iron
Ingredients Required: Muri (Puffed rice), Roasted peanuts, Boiled potato cubes, Chopped onions, Green chillies, Fresh coriander, Chanachur (Crispy snack mix), Raw Mustard oil, Spiced Muri Masala, Lemon juice
Recipe Instructions: 1. In a large tin/bowl, combine muri, peanuts, boiled potato, onions, chillies, chanachur, and coriander. 2. Sprinkle muri masala powder, lemon juice, and a generous splash of pungent raw mustard oil. 3. Toss vigorously and serve instantly in paper cones.

Key Nutrients: Protein (26g), Fat (20g), Carbohydrates (22g), Fiber (1g), Phosphorus, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Bhetki fish fillets, Onion-ginger-garlic juice, Green chilli paste, Cilantro paste, Lemon juice, Eggs, Breadcrumbs, Mustard oil for deep frying, Kasundi (Mustard dip)
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate rectangular Bhetki fillets in lemon juice, green herb paste, and onion-garlic juice for 1 hour. 2. Dip fish in beaten eggs, roll tightly in breadcrumbs, shape with a knife. 3. Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown. Serve hot with Kasundi mustard.

Key Nutrients: Protein (36g), Fat (38g), Carbohydrates (14g), Fiber (2g), Iron, Zinc, Vit B12
Ingredients Required: Goat Meat (Mutton), Sliced onions, Yogurt (Tok Doi), Ginger-garlic paste, Raw papaya paste (tenderizer), Mustard oil, Whole spices, Kashmiri red chilli powder, Sugar
Recipe Instructions: 1. Marinate mutton in curd, papaya paste, mustard oil, and spices for 2 hours. 2. Caramelize sugar in mustard oil for dark color, add whole spices and onions; brown deeply. 3. Add ginger-garlic paste, marinated mutton, and slow 'kosha' (sauté continuously) for 1.5 hours on low heat till dark, rich, and oil separates.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (52g), Fiber (8g), Folate, Iron
Ingredients Required: Chana dal (Bengal gram), Fried fried coconut bites, Raisins, Ginger paste, Bay leaf, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Cumin seeds, Hing, Ghee, Sugar, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Pressure cook chana dal with turmeric and salt till cooked but holding shape. 2. Temper ghee with bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, cumin seeds, hing, and ginger paste. 3. Add dal, fried coconut bites, raisins, and sugar. Cook until thick and serve hot with puffed Luchis.

Key Nutrients: Protein (14g), Fat (18g), Carbohydrates (51g), Fiber (8g), Folate, Iron
Ingredients Required: Chana dal, Fried coconut bits, Raisins, Hing (Asafoetida), Bay leaf, Cumin seeds, Cinnamon, Cardamom, Ghee, Sugar, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil chana dal until tender. 2. Heat ghee, temper bay leaf, cumin, cinnamon, cardamom, and generous hing (no ginger or root crops). 3. Add cooked dal, roasted coconut pieces, raisins, and sugar. Simmer till sweet-savory thick gravy forms.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (22g), Fiber (3g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Fresh Homemade Chana (Cottage cheese), Potato cubes, Maida (for binding), Ginger paste, Cumin paste, Tomato puree, Garam masala, Ghee, Cumin seeds, Bay leaf
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead chana with maida, cumin, and salt; shape into small diamonds and shallow fry in ghee. 2. Fry potato cubes till golden. 3. Temper ghee with cumin and bay leaf, sauté ginger and cumin paste, tomato puree; add water, potatoes, and fried chana koftas. Simmer gently.

Key Nutrients: Protein (16g), Fat (24g), Carbohydrates (18g), Fiber (2g), Calcium, Phosphorus
Ingredients Required: Fresh Chana (Paneer chana), Maida, Tomato puree, Cumin seeds, Hing, Bhaja masala, Garam masala, Ghee, Sugar, Salt
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead fresh chana with a spoonful of maida and salt; press onto tray, cut into diamond shapes, and light-fry in ghee. 2. Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and hing. Add tomato puree and dry spices, sauté until oil leaves sides. 3. Add water, boil, toss in fried chana cubes, and simmer for 5 minutes.

Key Nutrients: Protein (4g), Fat (2g), Carbohydrates (36g), Fiber (0g), Calcium
Ingredients Required: Fresh Chana (Cottage cheese from cow milk), Semolina/Maida (1 tsp), Sugar, Water, Rose water / Cardamom
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead fresh chana smoothly until non-greasy; roll into small crack-free smooth balls. 2. Boil thin sugar syrup (1:4 sugar to water ratio) in a wide pot. 3. Drop chana balls into boiling syrup, cover with lid, and boil vigorously for 15 minutes until spongy and doubled in size.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (8g), Carbohydrates (40g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Probiotics
Ingredients Required: Full-cream Milk, Sugar (caramelized), Fresh Yogurt (culture starter), Cardamom powder
Recipe Instructions: 1. Boil milk and reduce to 3/4th volume. 2. Melt sugar in a separate pan until it turns golden caramel, then pour into hot milk to give reddish-brown color. 3. Cool milk to lukewarm, stir in yogurt culture, pour into earthen clay pots, cover, and leave undisturbed in a warm spot to set overnight.

Key Nutrients: Protein (6g), Fat (6g), Carbohydrates (32g), Fiber (0g), Calcium, Magnesium
Ingredients Required: Fresh Chana (Cottage cheese), Date Palm Jaggery (Nolen Gur / Khejur Gur), Cardamom powder, Pistachios for garnish
Recipe Instructions: 1. Knead fresh soft chana smooth. 2. Cook chana and molten Nolen Gur in a non-stick pan over very low heat for 6-8 minutes without letting it dry out. 3. Remove, cool slightly, press into wooden molds (Sanch), unmold, and garnish with pistachios.

Key Nutrients: Protein (7g), Fat (10g), Carbohydrates (50g), Fiber (0.5g), Calcium, Vit B2
Ingredients Required: Gobindobhog Rice, Full-cream Milk, Sugar or Nolen Gur, Ghee, Bay leaf, Cardamom, Cashews, Raisins
Recipe Instructions: 1. Wash Gobindobhog rice and smear with ghee. 2. Boil milk with bay leaf and cardamom; reduce slightly. 3. Add rice and slow cook till soft and milk thickens. Add sugar/jaggery, cashews, and raisins; simmer for 5 minutes.
